blocks.text: Sugar Loaf, city tour and Corcovado

After breakfast, a private full-day excursion to Sugar Loaf and Corcovado. The first stop is Urca Hill, with its wide viewing area, restaurant and bar; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains and islands, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. Then drive to the old centre of Rio to admire its churches, monasteries, cathedral and colonial-style buildings.

Afterwards, go up to the top of Corcovado by train, with spectacular views of the Tijuca Forest, home to monkeys, exotic animals and birds. At 710 metres above sea level stands the symbol of Rio, the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the city and its surroundings: the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf and more.

Included: Private full-day tour Sugar Loaf, city and Corcovado (6 hours) · Breakfast

Day 3 · After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Manaus, where you are welcomed and taken to your lodge, with full board. During your stay you can enjoy the activities offered by the lodge at no extra cost:

Night boat ride (about 1 hour) · Leave the lodge by paddle or motor canoe to listen to the sounds of the jungle at night and spot caimans by torchlight, their eyes shining red among the foliage; your guide explains their habitat and behaviour. Visit to a caboclo family (about 1 hour) · Learn about the traditions of the riverside caboclo people and the history of the Amazon and the rubber cycle, and see how cassava flour is made and rubber sap is smoked. Fishing (40 minutes to 1 hour) · Try your luck at catching the elusive piranha, depending on the season, as your guide shows you a few tricks.
